traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets power. Large-scale ambition, intense conviction, and a drive to overhaul inherited beliefs. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Transformative ambition pursued with focus. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize growth and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what growth and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: One useful opportunity can provide enough leverage to change a condition that previously had to be worked around.

readerCopy.body: One useful opportunity can provide enough leverage to change a condition that previously had to be worked around. When Jupiter sextiles Pluto, growth and influence support each other, making money, access, authority, or the support of the right person unusually effective. The opening matters most when it changes the condition limiting the choices, not merely the appearance of the situation. Added power is most useful when more control remains after the opportunity passes.
